method.definition: gateway_cost = MCP_execute_wall − upstream_cost. ClawQL upstream_cost = paired same-host mock fetch (execute_i − direct_i). Executor upstream_cost = 0 (in-process return of identical JSON; no fetch).
method.interleaving: Each round: ClawQL execute → Executor execute → direct fetch. Drift hits both.
method.notTotalVsOverhead: Not comparing ClawQL overhead to Executor total-with-upstream. Executor equal arm has no upstream; subtracting 0 is the same definition.
method.coordinatedOmission: Closed-loop back-to-back (serial agent tool-call model). Do not claim load-test tail without LATENCY_OPEN_LOOP=1.
method.framing: Lead with absolute ClawQL oversight cost (p50/p999). Executor ratio is supporting evidence.

headline_absolute_ms.note: Absolute cost of ClawQL oversight path (execute − paired mock). Primary publish framing — holds regardless of Executor.

publish_lines.absolute: Risk gates, ring audit, hooks and field projection add 1.731 ms at p50 and 7.653 ms at p999 (durable WORM memory on).
publish_lines.vs_executor_supporting: Supporting: interleaved equal-arm Executor gateway_cost p50 2.449 ms (ratio 1.41× at p50).
